
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /trust                                     │
  │  Confirmation Trust                         │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    View or reset learned confirmation trust.

  Usage:
    /trust
    /trust reset [tool]
    /trust low
    /trust medium

  Details:
    RadSim learns which safe actions you routinely approve and can
    auto-confirm them (trust bandit). This command shows what has
    been learned, adjusts the trust threshold, or resets it.

  Examples:
    $ /trust
    $ /trust reset
    $ /trust reset write_file

  Related: /settings  /stats
